column3: ACH Direct Debit percentage rate. NOT a Homeworks-specific figure -- this is Stripe's own published ACH Direct Debit price, and Homeworks passes it through with NO markup (owner-confirmed 2026-07-31). STRUCTURAL CONTRAST WITH CARD, do not reason about the two alike: for card payments Homeworks adds a 1% platform markup on top of Stripe raw 2.9% + $0.30 for any tier below Enterprise (independently verified, HISTORY.md H-063), producing the blended 3.90% this ledger uses. ACH carries no such markup on either tier. Both route through Stripe; Homeworks marks up one and not the other. Cap interaction: the flat $5.00 cap (homeworks_ach_fee_cap) binds at exactly $625.00, since 0.8% x 625.00 = 5.00 -- above that the effective rate falls continuously with transaction size (a $5,000 ACH payment costs 0.1%, not 0.8%), unlike card 2.9% + $0.30 which has no ceiling. Relevant because CONTEXT.md Follow-Up #32 migrates COMMERCIAL clients, i.e. the largest invoices, which are exactly the ones above the cap. Promoted from BLOCKED to REFERENCE 2026-07-31 (HISTORY.md H-079) on the strength of the Stripe source; previously carried as owner-stated-only.
